description: This file defines the ProcessGroup class and related functions for distributed collective communication in PyTorch, including API declarations, backend management, and process group operations.

classes.name: ProcessGroup
classes.description: Base class for distributed process groups managing collective and point-to-point communication.

classes.name: MergeOptions
classes.description: Options for merging process groups, including timeout, group name, and description.

methods.name: getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the process within the group.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the process group.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the process group.

methods.name: getBackendID
methods.description: Returns an opaque ID correlating with the backend for collectives.

methods.name: getBackendName
methods.description: Returns the name of the backend as a string.

methods.name: getBackendType
methods.description: Returns the backend type enum.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for backend operations.

methods.name: startCoalescing
methods.description: Starts coalescing operations for a specific device type (e.g., NCCL).

methods.name: endCoalescing
methods.description: Ends coalescing operations for a specific device type.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Performs a broadcast operation on tensors.

methods.name: allreduce
methods.description: Performs an allreduce operation on tensors.

methods.name: allreduce_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced allreduce on multiple tensors.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Performs a reduce operation on tensors.

methods.name: allgather
methods.description: Performs an allgather operation on tensors.

methods.name: _allgather_base
methods.description: Deprecated; gathers a single buffer into a contiguous buffer.

methods.name: allgather_coalesced
methods.description: Deprecated; coalesced version of allgather.

methods.name: allgather_into_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Coalesced allgather into tensors.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Gathers tensors from all processes.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Scatters tensors to all processes.

methods.name: reduce_scatter
methods.description: Performs reduce-scatter operation.

methods.name: _reduce_scatter_base
methods.description: Base for reduce_scatter operation.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Coalesced reduce_scatter operation.

methods.name: alltoall_base
methods.description: Performs an alltoall operation with split sizes.

methods.name: alltoall
methods.description: Performs an alltoall operation on tensors.

methods.name: monitoredBarrier
methods.description: Performs a barrier with monitoring options.

methods.name: setSequenceNumberForGroup
methods.description: Initializes a sequence number for the group (supports GLOO, NCCL).

methods.name: getSequenceNumberForGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the current sequence number for the group.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends tensors to a specified rank.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receives tensors from a specified rank.

methods.name: recvAnysource
methods.description: Receives tensors from any source.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Performs a barrier synchronization.

methods.name: hasBackends
methods.description: Checks if backends are configured.

methods.name: setBackend
methods.description: Sets backend type for a device type.

methods.name: getDefaultBackend
methods.description: Returns the default backend for the process group.

methods.name: setDefaultBackend
methods.description: Sets the default backend type.

methods.name: getBackend
methods.description: Retrieves backend for a device type or backend type.

methods.name: getDeviceTypes
methods.description: Returns supported device types.

methods.name: registerOnCompletionHook
methods.description: Registers a hook to be called upon work completion.

methods.name: waitForPendingWorks
methods.description: Waits for all pending works to complete.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down all backends.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts all backends.

methods.name: hasHooks
methods.description: Checks if hooks are registered.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group's name.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the group's name.

methods.name: getGroupDesc
methods.description: Returns the group's description.

methods.name: setGroupDesc
methods.description: Sets the group's description.

methods.name: enableCollectivesTiming
methods.description: Enables timing for collectives.

methods.name: release_resources
methods.description: Releases internal resources.

methods.name: getBoundDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device the process group is bound to, if any.

methods.name: setBoundDeviceId
methods.description: Binds the process group to a specific device.

methods.name: splitGroup
methods.description: Creates a subgroup with specified ranks.

methods.name: mergeRemoteGroup
methods.description: Merges remote process groups.
